records.title: Reading, Not Thinking: Understanding and Bridging the Modality Gap When Text Becomes Pixels in Multimodal LLMs
records.reason: The abstract diagnoses text-as-image modality performance in multimodal LLMs and input rendering effects; it is a capability/evaluation study, not a compute optimization.

records.title: Logics-Parsing-Omni Technical Report
records.reason: The abstract proposes a general multimodal parsing taxonomy and staged perception/recognition pipeline; the subject is document/audio-visual parsing rather than LLM inference efficiency.

records.title: CLIPO: Contrastive Learning in Policy Optimization Generalizes RLVR
records.reason: The abstract introduces contrastive policy optimization for RLVR training rollouts and generalization; its intervention is training-time, not inference-time resource optimization.

records.title: Brain-WM: Brain Glioblastoma World Model
records.reason: The abstract models glioblastoma evolution and treatment with a clinical world model and MRI generation; it is a domain application, not LLM inference.

records.title: Diagnosing Retrieval vs. Utilization Bottlenecks in LLM Agent Memory
records.reason: The paper is a diagnostic study of memory write/retrieval strategies for LLM agents and identifies retrieval as a major accuracy bottleneck, but proposes no concrete inference optimization and measures task accuracy rather than serving cost; connection is useful but weak for this inference-focused corpus.
